title: Border Block
description: Adds Bedrock-style Border Blocks with customizable particles and block types.
body:
# Border Block

<font color="cyan">1.26+ | Paper, Spigot, Bukkit</font>

## About

Bring Border Blocks from Minecraft Bedrock Edition to your Java server.

This plugin adds custom Border Blocks that create vertical invisible barrier columns. Players cannot pass through them, teleport through them, ender pearl through them, or bypass them using boats.

Perfect for Survival Servers, PvP Servers, Hardcore Servers, Events, Adventure Maps, Minigames, Roleplay Servers and Spawn Protection.

![Image of Border Block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cf58a47bebea4e1dd9afad9344ac0c76e1f9035d.png)

## Features

* Bedrock Edition inspired Border Blocks

* Invisible barrier column above and below the Border Block

* Barriers only replace air blocks

* Existing builds are never overwritten

* Red particle effects to visualize borders

* Change Border Block type through an admin menu:

  * Red Concrete
  * Red Nether Brick Wall

* Ender Pearls are blocked by the border

* Boats are removed if they attempt to cross the border

* Survival players cannot break blocks above or below Border Blocks

![Border Block (Red Concrete Type)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/97d11ccb7aa47ab92731c45aadcba3b36a12f3f6.webp) ![Border Block (Red Nether Brick Wall Type)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a1c57b94cc9d000a464cc7d206793bcaf9860554.png)

## Menu

* Change Border Block type
* Increase particle density
* Decrease particle density
* Disable particles completely

![Border Block Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c4417333e10dffa5e63cfd787d30f1d061c96718_0.webp)

## Permissions

Tag yourself "admin" to access admin commands.

**Admin Tag**

/tag @s add admin

## Commands

<font color="red">**(Only players tagged "admin" can use Border Block custom commands)**</font>

/borderblockalex give - Gives yourself a Border Block.

/borderblockalex menu - Opens the Border Block settings menu.
